scope: Conservative evidence register for the user-supplied H33 attribution and H66 claims. No organizer-confirmed score is present. A DTI-like value from a local or owner report is not an organizer receipt.

claims.claim: The user-supplied brief associates the value 0.2778 with GEMSDOE32 artifact H33-2-B2.
claims.evidence_for: The attribution appears in user-provided context and owner-maintained project-family material (S17, S28).
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: The GEMSDOE32 owner page describes H33-2-B2 as unscored and says no organizer score exists for its artifacts (S18). No organizer receipt, submission identifier, date, or exact raster SHA-256 tied to the attribution is available here.
claims.verdict: UNATTRIBUTED. The claim may refer to a result, but this repository cannot establish that the exact H33-2-B2 bytes earned it.

claims.claim: If the reported H33 value is genuine, pruning predictions near mapped faults may have contributed to a metric change.
claims.evidence_for: Owner-maintained method descriptions characterize H33-2-B2 as a post-processing/pruning variant near mapped catalogue faults (S17, S31). The official metric penalizes false-positive and false-negative mass asymmetrically (S02).
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: There is no controlled same-fold comparison, exact byte-linked organizer receipt, private-label access, or counterfactual raster. Removing unsupported or redundant predictions could reduce false-positive contribution; removing predictions near genuinely new labels could reduce true-positive credit. Changes in preprocessing, raster bytes, submission identity, scoring time, or attribution mismatch also remain untested possibilities.
claims.verdict: PLAUSIBLE BUT NOT TESTED. No causal explanation or performance claim is supported.

claims.claim: A hand-built cultural-looking-feature veto on H66 lidar channels improves fault prediction.
claims.claim_type: HISTORICAL LOCAL NEGATIVE RESULT; NOT ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED
claims.evidence_for: The historical H66 off-catalogue SGMC instrument and local spatial-CV receipts are available as owner/local artifacts, not as competition-test labels. The recorded paired change interval crossed zero.
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: The feature is a geometry/TMI heuristic, not an existing labeled cultural-feature mask. The registered submission-policy holdout arm is recorded as HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0, has no 95% CI, and does not validate the emitted raster. The off-catalogue instrument is not the required organizer-label holdout. No fresh run is possible within the exhausted budget.
claims.verdict: NEGATIVE FOR CLEARANCE. Do not present the proxy or historical detector arm as proof of cultural-veto benefit.

claims.claim: Writing an all-finite raster fixes the previous '[0,1]' portal rejection.
claims.evidence_for: A local validator can check finite values and [0,1] against an authorized reference grid when those inputs are supplied.
claims.evidence_against_or_missing: No original rejected bytes, portal diagnostic receipt, or successful organizer acceptance tied to the archived TIFF is present. A range error could reflect values, nodata, array/grid interpretation, or other portal validation. NaN removal is not a verified remedy.
claims.verdict: UNKNOWN. The archived all-finite raster is not cleared for upload.

policy: Report performance only as HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive count and 95% CI, or as ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED from a receipt tied to the exact raster hash. Projections, owner-reported values, exploratory instruments, AUCs, and missing receipts are not scores.
